findings.message: GO-03 and IN-03 require the entire manifest-derived shipment to be self-contained, and ADR D3 explicitly includes unresolvable decision/constraint symbols in the prohibited references. AC-05 covers only concrete paths, while AC-06 checks those symbols only in shipped conventions. Other shipped files (commands, harness documents, README/configuration, etc.) can therefore retain unresolvable symbols while every AC still passes, leaving GO-03 without complete acceptance coverage.
findings.category: missing AC coverage for a stated goal

findings.message: GO-04 の「archive 業務ロジックを CLI / workflow に集約する」部分を検証する acceptance criterion がありません。AC-07 は command 文書が workflow を参照し、手動手順を含まないことだけを要求し、AC-08 は directory 由来の状態・表示だけを扱っています。そのため workflow が CLI に委譲せず archive 操作を再実装していても全 AC を満たせてしまい、GO-04 / IN-04 / D4 の単一業務ロジック化を完了条件として証明できません。

findings.message: `VerifyArgs` は非公開の `project_root` フィールドを持つため `has_stripped_fields` は `true` であるべきですが、`false` になっており baseline shape と不一致です。
`VerifyPort` の `verify_sotp_version_tag` / `verify_machine_paths` / `verify_template_refs` は filesystem/network I/O を行うポートなのに `is_async: false` で、同期実行を選ぶ理由が docs にありません。
`VerifyService` の読み取り専用メソッド群が `PathBuf` を値で受け取っています。実装は直ちに `&Path` としてポートへ渡しており、呼び出し側の所有権を奪う必要がありません。
`infrastructure::verify::machine_paths::verify` の docs が AC-12 の「全 Git-tracked file を走査し、machine-specific absolute path を fail-closed で検出する」という契約を散文で再記述しています。docs は型の責務と `AC-12` の参照に留めるべきです。
`infrastructure::verify::sotp_version_tag::verify` の docs が AC-03 の remote 上の Git URL/tag 解決と fail-closed 判定を散文で再記述しています。
`infrastructure::verify::template_refs::verify` の docs が AC-15 の manifest-derived shipped-template 集合、具体 source-repository key 検査、fail-closed 動作を散文で再記述しています。
`TemplateExportPortError` の docs が AC-13/CN-03 の exported file における machine-specific absolute path 拒否契約を散文で再記述しています。

`VerifyService` declares read-only operations such as `verify_latest_track` with owned `std::path::PathBuf` parameters, although the interactor immediately borrows them to call `VerifyPort`; this unnecessarily transfers ownership. Use borrowed `&Path` parameters consistently or document the ownership requirement.

`cli_driver::VerifyInput::CatalogueSpecRefs.track_id` が `Option<domain::ids::TrackId>` を参照していますが、`domain::ids` は private module のため外部 crate から参照できず、契約実装がコンパイル不能です。同じ誤った FQN が `usecase::VerifyPort` と `VerifyService` にもあります（各 `verify_catalogue_spec_refs`）。cli_driver は `usecase` のみ依存し docs も re-export を示すため、cli_driver は `usecase::TrackId`、usecase は `domain::TrackId` にすべきです。
`VerifyService` の読み取り専用メソッド（`verify_latest_track`、`verify_retention_gate` など）が `std::path::PathBuf` を値で受け取っています。ポート側は `&Path` であり、所有権を奪う必要がないため、呼び出し側に不要な move を強制します。

`VerifyService` の既存メソッド群が baseline の `PathBuf` 引数から `&Path` に一括変更されています（例: `verify_latest_track`）。briefing/spec が宣言する変更は3つの検証 route 追加であり、この未根拠の公開API変更は実装計画と baseline 契約を不整合にします。既存シグネチャを維持するか、変更を明示的に仕様化してください。

findings.message: T001–T017 descriptions do not name a concrete target file or symbol; they name only broad concepts such as “template export”, “verifier”, “CLI command surface”, or “shipped documents”. An executor must invent the implementation boundary, so rewrite each task as target + operation + anchor cite.

T001 restates the AC-01/AC-02 behavior contract in prose (“ignored temporary files are skipped” while other paths “remain fail-closed”) instead of limiting the task text to target, operation, and anchors.

T004–T006 restate upstream acceptance/out-of-scope behavior (publish-readiness versus initial install, permitted absolute paths and directory allowlists, and the five reference fixtures/semantic-review boundary). These details belong in spec.json; the tasks should cite the relevant anchors after naming concrete symbols.

T017 repeats the D2/D3/D5/D6/D7 behavior contract (“uses the exported runtime”, “scans exported output”, “preserves the non-tag-dependent path”, and “fails closed”) rather than describing the concrete CI/smoke files and operation with anchor cites.

Section S1 and S5 descriptions restate upstream behavior and constraints (“ignoring only untracked ignored temporary input”, “full Git-tracked-file inventory”, and no directory allowlist). Plan sections should summarize task ordering and references, not duplicate the spec contract.

Section S6 restates upstream design rationale in “This enforces the D6/D7 ordering constraint while connecting D2 verification to delivery checks.” Keep the section description to executable target/operation plus anchor citations per `no-upstream-restatement.md`.

T017 says to add all three verifier invocations to `template-export-smoke-local`, but the fixed-tag verifier would make export smoke depend on a resolvable tag, contradicting AC-04/OS-02. Specify that fixed-tag verification is CI-only and keep export smoke limited to export-safe gates.

T014 maps AC-08 but only names the workflow, command bridge, and `execute_archive`; it does not name or validate the rendered registry/archive view derived from `track/archive/`. The task can therefore complete without covering the required Archived display behavior.

AC-06 is mapped only to T012, but T013 is the task that rewrites the remaining include/overlay shipped documents and configuration. Without mapping AC-06 to T013 (and citing it in T013), those files may retain concrete ADR/track references while coverage still passes.

AC-04 is mapped to T004, but T004 only adds the standalone version-tag verifier and tag fixtures; it does not wire or validate the export-smoke requirement that a fixed tag is not mandatory. Remove this mapping (and the corresponding T004 anchor) or add explicit smoke non-integration work; T017 is the described carrier for this behavior.

T013 reviews the resolved shipped set before T014 rewrites `.claude/commands/track/archive.md` and creates the shipped `.harness/workflows/track/archive.md`; consequently the final shipped files are not covered by the AC-05/AC-06 review mapped only to T012/T013. Reorder T014 before the review or add a post-T014 reference check.

T016 broadly instructs rewriting “host-specific or external temporary paths” without limiting changes to paths carrying work-machine information. This permits rewriting system/container/example paths that CN-03 and OS-05/AC-10 explicitly require preserving. Restrict T016 to remaining machine-path matches and qualifying external paths.

T013 appears before T014 in the task list, yet its AC-05/AC-06 review must cover files created or rewritten by T014. Make the T014→T013 dependency explicit in executable task ordering or add a post-T014 reference-check task.

T016 permits rewriting “host-specific or external temporary paths” without requiring that the occurrence carries work-machine information. This can alter system, container, or example paths preserved by CN-03/OS-05/AC-10; restrict it to qualifying machine-path matches.
T015 は全 inventory の `workspace-rooted machine-path occurrences` を対象にする一方、T016 は同じ inventory の「remaining qualifying」matches としか定義していません。第1・第2バッチの具体的なパターン／対象境界がなく、実装者が T016 の対象を推測する必要があります。

T015 is a split candidate: the complete tracked-file inventory currently contains 1,809 lines with the specified workspace prefix, so this single task would exceed the 500-line diff ceiling by multiple times. Split the rewrite into smaller semantic batches.

T015–T018 cannot cover the stated AC-09/AC-12 inventory: the current `git ls-files` tree contains 2,334 workspace-rooted machine-path lines, while the four batches promise only 450+450+450+459 = 1,809 findings. T018 can therefore finish with at least 525 matches remaining, after which T019 enables the fail-closed gate. Recompute the batch count from the actual inventory or make the final task explicitly gated on zero findings.

D7 defers the exact detection pattern and implementation to implementation time. Terms such as “date-time-shaped ADR filename” and “track ID with a date suffix” do not define the accepted grammar, path boundaries, or placeholder/false-positive handling, so downstream spec and implementations can produce materially different gates. Define observable matching rules and required cases before implementation.
